endorsements.quote: Before LLMs can be approved and used widely in clinical settings, contextualised evaluations with the setting up of suitable guardrails are necessary to ensure patient safety.
Another approach involves adversarial testing to probe for different failure modes and conditions whereby LLMs will generate harmful and biased outputs11.

unlisted_practices: Develop robust frameworks for data auditing and provenance tracking to enable effective regulatory oversight of LLM-based tools.
Regulators, manufacturers, and researchers should converge on clinically relevant evaluation methodology and metrics for LLMs.
Provide interdisciplinary training and capacity-building programs for regulatory authorities and healthcare professionals to manage AI technologies.
Bring together bioethicists, regulators, end-users, legal experts, and developers in multidisciplinary collaboration on LLM governance.
Regulators should adopt adaptive and anticipatory regulatory approaches, including regulatory sandboxes, for LLM-based medical devices.
Develop global regulatory sandboxes to study international interoperability of regulatory policies.
Establish a global independent body to create voluntary frameworks that evolve into trusted industry standards guiding vendor onboarding and due diligence.
Strengthen supply chain visibility, resilience teams, and business continuity plans for AI in healthcare delivery.
Support health systems in building local (on-premises or edge) AI deployment infrastructure to reduce dependence on commercial cloud products.
Include LMIC perspectives and researchers in global regulatory science collaboration and capacity building.
Align reporting and governance checklists and consolidate initiatives for LLM evaluation and reporting.
Regulators should revise risk classification and control requirements for LLM-based medical devices and strengthen enforcement against unapproved consumer LLM medical applications.
Explore federated learning and blockchain to enable privacy-preserving, auditable data collaboration for LLM development.
Conduct post-launch monitoring and policy optimisation of fine-tuned conversational LLMs to reduce cognitive biases and model drift.
